source.label: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026, cover page
source.quote: The registrant had outstandi n g 33,774,121 shares of Class A common stock as of September 4, 2026.

notes: One class of common stock, listed on Nasdaq as RENT; no Class B or preferred shares are outstanding (all Class B converted into Class A on October 28, 2025, and the authorized Class B and preferred were eliminated in July 2026). The count is from the cover of the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 31, 2026 (filed September 11, 2026), the latest filing; the 10-Q for the quarter ended October 31, 2026 had not been filed. The cover's text is quoted as extracted ('outstandi n g' is split in the HTML).
